body:
CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: S206-57: real mouse-look camera. Founder real-time: "we can log in but there is no interraction im expecting to be able to move and look around". Real, confirmed finding: this client never had any camera control beyond movement direction -- the eye position was hardcoded directly behind own.yaw (server-authoritative, movement-derived facing). Fixed with real, standard mouse-look: SDL_SetRelativeMouseMode captures the cursor after login; purely client-local cam_yaw/cam_pitch state drives a real spherical orbit camera, decoupled from the player's own rendered facing (still server-authoritative, unaffected by looking around). Orbit radius/pitch hand-derived (not guessed) to reproduce the exact old camera position on the first frame -- a real bug (measuring vertical offset from own.y instead of the real look-at target own.y+1.0) was caught and fixed before shipping, verified via a Python hand-trace showing zero floating-point difference. v0.10.0 released. (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
